login_desc: You can only use a secret key to access an existing account. This is because the desktop client stores your login information locally on your computer, so your account is as safe as the security of your personal computer.
create_new_account_info: Wallet will create a local file for your secret that will be encrypted with password of your choice. Encrypted file is not recommended way to access your wallet. Please consider a hardware wallet.
pwd_weak: Your password is weak. It is not a mix of letters, numbers and symbols.
security_notice: The secret key below gives access to your money in the unlikely case that you lose your password. With this secret key alone anyone can retrieve your money. So please store it somewhere PRIVATE AND SAFE.
are_you_sure_secret: Are you in a safe place where no person or camera can see your screen?
save_safe: Have you saved your secret key/menemonic somewhere safe?
yes_save: Yes, I saved my secret key
trust_src: This is a list of gateways from the XRP Ledger community.
trust_note: Note: We do NOT endorse any of these gateways.
trust_noremove_desc: No need to remove the trust
fed_desc: Look up the tokens an issuer publishes in its xrp-ledger.toml.
issuer_invalid: Asset issuer account ID must be a valid account ID
name_or_address: Contact name or XRP Ledger address
send_note: Note: The target address must also trust the asset you are sending.
tag_need: Recipient requires a destination tag to be specified for the transaction. If you don't know the destination tag, please contact them before doing a transaction.
msg_need: Recipient requires a message to be specified for the transaction.
disallow_xrp: Recipient does not allow {{code}} payments. Are you sure you want to send {{code}} anyway?
invalid_address: Recipient should be either a name from your contact list or an XRP Ledger address.
not_funded: Not funded. To create this account, send it at least 20 {{name}}s ({{code}}).
no_send_path: Unable to find a path between you and the destination account.
send_with_err: If the path is unavailable, you can still send directly.
no_contact: You don't have any contacts yet. Click on 'Add contact' button in the top right corner to add a new contact.
error_already_name: You already have a contact with the same name.
convert_nopath: No acceptable path. Please make sure your account has enough funds / trustline limit.
submitting: Sending transaction to the XRP Ledger
act_will_upd: Your account will update once the transaction has cleared.
rest_cancel: . The rest of your order has been cancelled due to lack of funds.
you_sell: You created an order to sell
you_buy: You created an order to buy
you_cancel_buy: You cancelled an order to buy
you_cancel_sell: You cancelled an order to sell
bal_change: Your balance has been changed by
order_cancel_due: , has been cancelled due to lack of funds.
fatfinger: CAUTION: Your order is far off from the current market price.
no_bids: There are currently no bids for this pair.
no_asks: There are currently no asks for this pair.
vote_notice: Please set the fee from 0% to 1%.
AMMVote: AMM - Vote on the AMM's trading fee.
AMMDeposit: AMM - Add funds to an existing AMM.
AMMWithdraw: AMM - Return LP Tokens to an AMM to remove funds.
switch_net_desc: Switch between XRP Ledger networks. Test networks are for testing and are reset occasionally, so don’t rely on balances or accounts there.
max_fee_desc: Maximum fee to use with transactions.
timeout_desc: Timeout in seconds before considering a request to have failed.
fed_ripple_desc: When you enter an XRP Ledger address, this domain is used to resolve it.
fed_bitcoin_desc: When you enter a Bitcoin address, it will use below domain to parse.
domain_desc: A domain name that can optionally be added to the account. Clients can look up more details from this domain.
disallowxrp: Indicates that client applications should not send XRP to this account. Not enforced by rippled.
requiretag: Requires incoming payments to specify a destination tag.
setrippling: Enable rippling on this account’s trust lines by default. Do NOT enable it unless you are a issuer.
messagekey_desc: Public key for sending encrypted messages to this account.
merge_desc: Danger operation! It transfers your {{code}} to destination account. Fee:
account_noclean: Your account should have no obligations.
merge_done: Your account was merged to destination.
dw_desc_line1: If you want to deposit or withdraw funds, either in fiat or from other blockchains, you may use an gateway service to do so.
dw_desc_line2: You'll find a selection of service providers in the tabs below. Start by choosing a provider.
no_trust: Please create the trust line first.
wallet_notice1: Your money and wallet are protected digitally through encryption algorithms that can be unlocked only with your personal keys.
wallet_notice2: No one else has them, so don't lose them! Please backup your secret carefully.
app_open_source: This app is open source now.
github_feedback: You can submit an issue on github if there are any problems.
qq_feedback: You can also find us in QQ group 703611153.
NotFoundError: The resource was not found. You must have some {{code}} in your account for it to be activated!
NoFederationUrl: Xrc20 service url was not provided.
watch_only_banner: Watch-only wallet: you can view this account, but signing transactions is disabled.
tx_pending: Submitted. Waiting for the ledger to validate it...
auth_hero_title: Your keys. Your XRP. The whole XRP Ledger.
auth_hero_sub: A desktop wallet that keeps your keys on this computer and gives you the full XRP Ledger: payments, the DEX, AMMs, NFTs and more.
auth_feat_keys_desc: Secrets are encrypted in a file on your computer and never sent anywhere.
auth_feat_dex_desc: Use the built-in decentralized exchange and automated market makers.
auth_feat_xrpl_desc: NFTs, escrow, checks, payment channels, multi-signing and more.
login_sub: Unlock the encrypted wallet file stored on this computer.
watch_only_desc: Watch any account without its keys. You can view balances and activity, but not sign transactions.
create_blank_desc: Generate a fresh account with a recovery phrase.
import_mnemonic_desc: Restore from a 12 or 24 word recovery phrase.
import_secret_desc: Use an existing family seed (starts with "s").
backup_warning: Anyone with your secret key or recovery phrase can take your funds. Never share it with anyone.
assets_sub: XRP and the tokens this account holds
no_tokens_desc: Add a trust line to hold tokens issued on the XRP Ledger.
account_not_activated: This account is not activated yet
receive_sub: Share your address to receive XRP and tokens on the XRP Ledger.
receive_tag_hint: Exchanges and shared accounts use a tag to identify who a payment is for.
x_address_hint: An X-address packs the address and tag together so senders can't forget the tag.
receive_tokens_hint: To receive a token other than XRP, you first need a trust line to its issuer.
send_sub: Pay any XRP Ledger account. Cross-currency payments are routed automatically through the DEX and AMMs.
send_enter_details: Enter a recipient and an amount to see payment options.
activity_sub: Every transaction that touched this account, newest first.
AMMBid: AMM - Bid on the auction slot.
contacts_sub: Saved recipients are stored inside your encrypted wallet file.
tokens_sub: Trust lines let this account hold tokens issued by other accounts. Each one uses part of your XRP reserve.
trust_remove_balance: Send away or sell the balance before removing the trust line.
no_gateways: No listed gateways on this network
no_gateways_desc: Use "Add manually" to trust any issuer.
trade_pick_sub: Pick a base asset and a counter asset.
amm_sub: Provide liquidity to the XRP Ledger's automated market makers and earn a share of trading fees.
auction_slot_desc: The slot holder trades against this pool at a discounted fee for up to 24 hours.
single_asset_hint: A single-asset deposit is charged a fee, as if half of it were swapped.
vote_weight_hint: Your vote is weighted by the LP tokens you hold.
auth_accounts_hint: Up to 4 other accounts that may also trade at the discounted fee.
amm_empty: This pool is empty. You can delete it to free the ledger objects.
no_pool_desc: There is no AMM for this pair yet. The first depositor sets the starting price.
create_pool_fee: Creating a pool burns a special transaction fee equal to one owner reserve.
how_amm_1: Pools hold two assets and quote prices from their ratio. Swaps and cross-currency payments use a pool automatically when it offers the best rate.
how_amm_2: Liquidity providers receive LP tokens for their share and earn the trading fee, which LP holders vote on.
nft_sub: Mint, hold and trade non-fungible tokens natively on the XRP Ledger.
my_offers_sub: Buy and sell offers you created. Each holds one owner reserve until it is accepted or cancelled.
no_nfts_desc: Mint your own, or buy one from another account.
no_nft_offers: You have no open NFT offers.
nft_uri_hint: Usually a link to JSON metadata or an image (max 256 bytes).
transfer_fee_hint: Paid to the issuer on each resale (0 - 50%).
mint_for_issuer_hint: Only if that account authorized you as its NFT minter.
nft_load_media_hint: Loads each NFT's image and details from the server its creator chose. That server can see your IP address.
nft_tip_1: NFTs are stored in pages of up to 32; each page counts as one owned object for your reserve.
nft_tip_2: Flags and royalty are permanent once minted.
make_buy_offer_sub: Offer to buy an NFT owned by another account.
broker_sale_sub: Match a sell offer with a buy offer and keep the difference as a fee.
transfer_free: Transfer for free to a specific account
nft_destination_hint: Only this account can accept the offer.
burn_confirm: Burning destroys this NFT permanently. Continue?
escrow_sub: Lock XRP until a time passes or a crypto-condition is fulfilled. Escrows are released to the recipient, or returned after they expire.
no_escrows_desc: Escrows you create or receive appear here.
release_after_hint: The recipient (or anyone) can release the funds after this time.
escrow_expire_hint: After this time the escrow can only be cancelled, and the XRP returns to you.
crypto_condition_hint: PREIMAGE-SHA-256 condition (hex). Releasing will require the matching fulfillment.
escrow_reserve_hint: Each escrow holds one owner reserve until it is released or cancelled.
escrow_sequence_hint: The sequence of the EscrowCreate transaction could not be looked up. Enter it manually.
checks_sub: A check is a deferred payment: the sender authorizes up to an amount, and the recipient decides when to cash it.
no_checks_desc: Checks you write or receive appear here until they are cashed or cancelled.
check_max_hint: Funds stay in your account until the check is cashed.
cash_flexible_hint: Receive as much as possible, but at least this amount.
channels_sub: Stream many small XRP payments off-ledger. The sender signs claims; the recipient redeems the latest one on-ledger whenever they like.
no_channels_desc: Open a channel to pay someone in tiny increments without a transaction for each payment.
channel_amount_hint: Set aside from your balance; unclaimed XRP returns to you when the channel closes.
settle_delay_hint: How long the recipient has to redeem claims after you ask to close.
new_expiration_hint: Optional. Extends a channel that is closing.
sign_claim_hint: Claims are cumulative. Sign the total amount the recipient should be able to redeem so far, then send them the claim.
account_settings_sub: On-ledger settings for this account. Every change is a signed transaction.
flag_asfRequireDest_desc: Incoming payments must include a destination tag.
flag_asfDisallowXRP_desc: Tells wallets not to send XRP to this account. Not enforced by the ledger.
flag_asfDepositAuth_desc: Only accounts you preauthorize can send you funds.
flag_asfDisallowIncomingTrustline_desc: Other accounts can't open trust lines to this account.
flag_asfDisallowIncomingCheck_desc: Other accounts can't write checks to this account.
flag_asfDisallowIncomingPayChan_desc: Other accounts can't open payment channels to this account.
flag_asfDisallowIncomingNFTokenOffer_des: Other accounts can't create NFT offers directed at this account.
flag_asfDefaultRipple_desc: Enable rippling on trust lines by default. Only issuers should enable this.
flag_asfRequireAuth_desc: Holders need your approval before they can hold tokens you issue.
flag_asfGlobalFreeze_desc: Freeze all tokens issued by this account.
flag_asfGlobalFreeze_confirm: Freeze every token this account has issued?
flag_asfNoFreeze_desc: Permanently give up the ability to freeze tokens you issue.
flag_asfNoFreeze_confirm: This can never be undone. Permanently give up the ability to freeze tokens?
flag_asfAllowTrustLineClawback_desc: Lets this account claw back tokens it issues. Only possible while the account owns no objects.
flag_asfAllowTrustLineClawback_confirm: This can never be undone. Enable clawback for tokens this account issues?
flag_asfDisableMaster_desc: Only the regular key or signer list can sign. Requires one of them to be set.
flag_asfDisableMaster_confirm: Make sure your regular key or signers work before continuing. If you lose them, you lose this account. Disable the master key?
messagekey_eth: This is an Ethereum address (converted automatically)
regular_key_sub: A secondary key pair that can sign for this account. You can rotate it, or disable the master key once it is set.
regular_key_master_disabled: The master key is disabled, so the regular key can't be removed.
multi_signing_sub: Require several keys to approve transactions. A transaction is valid when its signers' weights reach the quorum.
deposit_auth_sub: When enabled, only accounts you preauthorize can send you funds.
tickets_sub: Reserve sequence numbers so transactions can be prepared and submitted out of order (useful for multi-signing).
issuer_settings_sub: Settings that apply to tokens this account issues.
transfer_rate_hint: Charged when users send your tokens to each other (0 - 100%).
tick_size_hint: Significant digits for exchange rates of offers involving your tokens (3 - 15, or 0 to clear).
nft_minter_hint: Lets another account mint NFTs with this account as the issuer.
clawback_sub: Recover tokens you issued from a holder. Requires the "Allow trust line clawback" flag.
clawback_disabled: Clawback is not enabled for this account.
did_sub: Attach a W3C DID document, URI or attestation data to this account.
did_active: This account has a DID on the ledger.
delete_requirements: The account must not own trust lines, escrows, payment channels or other objects that block deletion, and must be at least 256 ledgers old.
delete_understand: I understand this permanently deletes the account.
security_sub: Your keys never leave this computer. Back them up and keep them offline.
security_tip_1: Write your recovery phrase on paper and store it somewhere safe. Never keep it in a screenshot or a cloud note.
security_tip_2: For large balances, set up a regular key or multi-signing in Account settings and keep the master key offline.
settings_sub: Network, servers and appearance. These settings are stored on this computer only.
save_reconnect_hint: Saving reconnects and reloads the wallet.
copied_secret: Hidden for safety. It will be cleared from the clipboard in 30 seconds.
nft_accept_confirm: Accept this offer for {{amount}}? Check the currency and its issuer: tokens can be named like XRP.
auto_lock_desc: Lock the wallet after this long without keyboard or mouse activity. You then need your password again. Watch-only wallets are not locked.
locked_inactive: The wallet was locked after {{minutes}} minutes without activity. Open it again to continue.
poison_dust: A tiny payment from an address that isn't in your contacts. Scammers send these from addresses that look like ones you use, hoping you'll later copy theirs from your history. Copy addresses from your contacts or the original source instead.
poison_lookalike: This address looks like your contact {{name}}, but it's a different address. Don't send to it.
poison_lookalike_self: This address looks like your own address, but it's a different address. Don't send to it.
send_lookalike: This address looks like your contact {{name}} ({{address}}) but is different. Check every character before sending.
send_lookalike_self: This address looks like your own address but is different. Check every character before sending.
